verdict.rationale: Pylon publishes a complete OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at its API origin (api.usepylon.com/openapi.json). It covers 119 paths and is downloadable as plain JSON with no auth wall, and the GitBook API reference is rendered from it. The probe's 404s were only on docs.usepylon.com candidate paths, a different origin, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the download at the api.usepylon.com origin.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Pylon publishes a complete OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at its API origin (info title "Pylon API.", 119 paths, US and EU server entries), downloadable as plain JSON with no auth wall.
The API reference renders GitBook's in-page "Test it" runner per endpoint, driven by the published spec.
